desc: This Kimber Magazine is a standard factory replacement magazine. It is designed for use in Kimber Micro 9 RAPIDE pistols chambered in 9mm Luger and holds 7 rounds of ammunition. It is made from high quality steel and features a polymer base pad with a pinky extension to allow for a full grip. Additionally, it is worth noting that the magazine is made to Kimber's specifications and tolerances, using the same manufacturing process and materials as the original equipment magazines which shipped with your firearm. This will ensure not only a perfect fit but exceptional operation.
